screens.name: Pig list tab
screens.zh: 母猪产后检查猪只列表

notes.purpose: Sows to check after farrowing, by pen; lens To check / Checked / All. A rail task: tap the row.

elements.name: Task row
elements.shows: one sow (or litter): tag, one fact line, one memory line, rail

states.when: a flagged item brings her back (research)
states.shows: Recheck · due today with one chip naming the item
Checked · ok, "BCS 3 · milk ok · 09:00 G.H", edit pencil

elements.logic: Line 1 is words (state + when), line 2 is tokens (history, stamps). A chip appears only for an escalated measurement or a flagged observation; stamps appear on done rows and on rows that descend from a record. Everything on the row is derived; the worker types nothing here.

elements.name: Lens row
elements.logic: Filter extras (research): farrowed 1d to 5d or more, abnormal item, cull recommended.

elements.name: Unit KPI and Task overview
elements.shows: 90% pass, target 90 or more; Task overview "100/200 checked", day n of 3
elements.logic: The pass definition is not documented anywhere (research Q2).

issues: Pre-Astra look: rows, header and dock predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: The sheet behind the Task overview cell for postpartum check: whole-task progress, KPI, configuration, SOP link and, where the task has one, End task. What failed the "does this change what a hand does at the pen right now?" test lives here, one tap from the room.

elements.name: End task
elements.shows: Red button at the bottom of the sheet.
elements.rule: Per the research: End task is disabled with a stated reason while the batch's farrowing task is open. On an early end, the confirm states that unchecked sows keep following the batch; what that means for compliance is open (research Q5).

elements.name: Configuration
elements.logic: Starts day 1 after farrowing, window 3 days.

issues: Pre-Astra look: header, KPI cells and sheet styling predate the Astra task skeleton.

notes.purpose: The assessment for one sow, opened by tapping the row. The earlier deck shows a compact form and footnotes the rest.

elements.name: Assessment fields
elements.shows: the full set of answers the check records

states.shows: segmented, with thin, standard, obese anchors
four values; "none" is a recorded answer
a reason field appears only when recommend

elements.logic: Which results schedule the recheck, and the interval, are not documented (research Q1). Whether all nine answers are required, or a partial save is legal, is open (research Q4).
elements.rule: Save commits the check; there is no round submit. Any abnormal item creates a symptom record and a recheck row; the sheet confirms in one line.

issues: The compact sheet in the earlier deck shows only BCS, mastitis, feeding and cull; the research specifies all nine fields.

notes.purpose: Read-only list, check detail and task detail after the task ends.
